newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT, Ionics fall on correction.
newsitem.headline: PLDT, Ionics fall on correction.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co and Ionics Circuits Inc, companies seen benefiting from a weak peso, fell into negative territory by late trade in a technical correction, brokers said.
PLDT shed 35 pesos to 930 pesos while Ionics slipped one peso to 18.75 pesos.
"These issues have had a healthy run-up. It's time for them to correct," said Helen Alvarez, research director at All Asia Securities.
PLDT and Ionics have been on the rise following the latest speculative attacks on the peso.
PLDT sources 50 percent of its revenues from international calls while Ionics relies on exports of its electronic products.
Both issues were among the most actively traded stocks by late session.
